name: @office/marketplace
description: Office marketplace catalog & lifecycle engine (OFF-027): tenant-scoped publisher registration and revocation, immutable app releases pinned to validated AppManifests, the queryable catalog (an AppCatalogSource), explicit revocable tenant entitlements, installation metadata linkage onto app-runtime AppInstallation identities, staged updates with the A9 permission-delta review (added capabilities require fresh confirmation), rollback, uninstall severance, and the typed audit ledger every lifecycle transition lands in — canonical project state provably untouched (A11). Depends only on @office/app-sdk, the TYPE-ONLY installation surface of @office/app-runtime, @office/authz, @office/contracts, and @office/domain-kernel; the marketplace never executes app code (A7), never constructs the action gateway or the app runtime, and never mutates canonical project state.
